points.point: how to get around the Pinterest 'site doesn't allow you to save Pins' error
points.sentence: Workaround: append parameters to your link (e.g., ?ref=pin&v=111) so Pinterest sees it as a new URL that bypasses the filter.

points.point: why this happens when the link is the customer's own food blog
points.sentence: Two common causes: 1) The website indicated they do not want to be pinned. 2) Pinterest's blocklist flagged your URL (often a false positive).

verdict.reason: The entry matches the exact Pinterest error, explains its causes (including a blocklist false positive that fits a customer's own blog), and gives the URL-parameter workaround the customer asks for.
